# annotation motivation

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:annotationMotivation`](gmeow-annotationMotivation.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/annotationMotivation>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/notes`](../../slices/notes.md)

The motivation of an annotation — the purpose for which the body is attached to the target. Functional per relator: one motivation per [`Annotation`](../classes/gmeow-Annotation.md). An open value vocabulary of individuals ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)); no motivation is privileged as primary.
